title: Add local/test auth bootstrap path
safety_requirements: Disabled unless an explicit local/test profile is active
Fails startup if enabled in production
Does not weaken the production auth path
Covered by a test proving the production profile rejects the bypass
which_gap_it_addresses: Authenticated smoke flows require a manual browser login, so the harness cannot run non-interactive proof.
which_harness_command_or_proof_level_it_: L3 authenticated runtime interaction, possibly L4 with a side-effect check
why_it_is_better_than_more_documentation: It makes authenticated behavior runnable and assertable by an agent instead of described in prose.
